+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M3A6D0PH2N6Z6BWHGJ8KGEGV
+- 01M3A6CQGZZC4VNCQM2Z6EPJ2M
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8880'
+title: 'Decision A: an agent gets the agents tool only when its tools key lists Agent'
+---
+## Decision (recommended; confirm or change before /finish)
+In Claude Code, sub-agents do not start sub-agents by default. Now `ToolVocabulary.everything` (`Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Tools/ToolSelection.swift`) gives an agent with no `tools` key the full catalog, and that includes the `agents` tool. Most Claude agent files have no `tools` key, so each of them can start any agent, itself too, down to `maxDepth`. The recommendation: the `agents` tool is given only by an explicit `Agent` or `Agent(a, b)` entry in `tools`.
+
+## What
+- Leave `agents` out of the "no `tools` key" catalog. `Agent` / `Agent(a, b)` in `tools` still gives it.
+- Update plan.md §5, the README, `docs/skills-and-agents.md` if it mentions it, and the DocC articles.
+- `runner.catalog()` tool warnings follow the new rule.
+- Update fixtures and tests that expect an agent with no `tools` key to have the `agents` tool (for example the live-test note that such an agent can start agents, and `ToolResolverTests`).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] An agent with no `tools` key has every catalog tool except `agents`.
+- [ ] `tools: Agent` gives the `agents` tool with all names; `tools: Agent(a, b)` limits it to `a` and `b`.
+- [ ] `disallowedTools: Agent` still removes it.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Cases in `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/ToolResolverTests.swift` and `NestedRunTests.swift`.
+- [ ] Run `swift test -Xswiftc -warnings-as-errors`, then `cd IntegrationTests && swift test`. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+- Update the tests and fixtures that expect an agent with no `tools` key to have the `agents` tool: `ToolResolverTests.swift`, `NestedRunTests.swift` (and `+Limits`), and the live agent files in `IntegrationTests/Tests/AgentsIntegrationTests/` (an answer-only agent no longer needs `disallowedTools: Agent`).
+- The documents change in `^Decision A docs`.

+- [ ] `tools: Agent` and `tools: agents` give the `agents` tool with all names; `tools: Agent(a, b)` limits it to `a` and `b`.
